title: $30 million bonds for Molokaʻi land purchases
summary: Bills 150 and 151 would allow $30 million in bond borrowing for Molokaʻi land purchases. The vice chair noted the bills do not name parcels, acreage, sellers or values. The managing director said the county must get council approval before buying any property.
